walkthrough.title: One birthday. The whole restaurant desk.
walkthrough.caption: The main FormBridge workspace · A fictional guest enquiry
walkthrough.voice: Let's follow Alex's birthday dinner through the main FormBridge workspace. This is the normal booking desk, with the enquiry book, service planner and desk assistant available throughout.

walkthrough.title: 01 · Start with the guest’s own words
walkthrough.caption: Juniper House · Sydney · 13 November · Four guests
walkthrough.voice: Alex asks for four people at Juniper House in Sydney, on the thirteenth of November at seven. The message also mentions a birthday, a peanut allergy and a quiet table. Add it to the brief.

walkthrough.title: Bring an existing conversation
walkthrough.caption: Paste a single enquiry, or label Customer and Staff messages
walkthrough.voice: For an existing enquiry, Paste conversation accepts a single message or a labelled customer and staff transcript. It starts a new brief, so keep your current enquiry first.

walkthrough.title: 02 · Hear the change of plans
walkthrough.caption: Upload or record a short voice message
walkthrough.voice: Alex changes the plans by voice. In this example, we upload a short recording asking for six guests and sometime after eight. FormBridge transcribes it for review.

walkthrough.title: Check the transcript before using it
walkthrough.caption: Review the words, then use them in the composer
walkthrough.voice: Read the transcript before putting it into the conversation. Voice input follows the same review and extraction flow as a typed message.

walkthrough.title: 03 · Keep uncertainty visible
walkthrough.caption: Six guests. After eight. An exact time still to agree.
walkthrough.voice: The guest count changes to six. After eight stays an unresolved preference. The brief asks for an exact time, and the change history keeps the earlier details visible.

walkthrough.title: 04 · Ask the desk assistant for a reply
walkthrough.caption: A suggested reply stays under staff control
walkthrough.voice: Open Desk assistant and ask for a warm reply suggesting eight-thirty. The assistant prepares wording for staff to review. Use in composer places it in a staff message, ready to check and send.

walkthrough.title: Turn the next step into something useful
walkthrough.caption: Review proposed follow-ups and next-shift notes
walkthrough.voice: The assistant can also suggest a follow-up and a shift note. Here, staff keeps a reminder about the quiet table and a note to check the allergy with the guest and kitchen. Save the enquiry to retain these changes.

walkthrough.title: 05 · Let the guest agree
walkthrough.caption: The staff suggestion and guest acceptance support 8:30 pm
walkthrough.voice: Add the staff suggestion, then Alex's acceptance. Eight-thirty is now the agreed time in the brief. Open Time to read the messages supporting it, including the offer and the guest's yes.

walkthrough.title: Correct the conversation when needed
walkthrough.caption: Edit a message or correct its speaker, then review the rebuilt brief
walkthrough.voice: If a message or speaker was entered incorrectly, edit it directly. FormBridge rebuilds the brief from the corrected conversation and asks staff to review the result again.

walkthrough.title: 06 · Keep the details that need extra care
walkthrough.caption: Read each quotation before keeping the request
walkthrough.voice: Find guest requests in Guest care. Each suggestion comes with the customer's words. Keep Alex's name, birthday, quiet table and peanut allergy after reviewing them. Dietary arrangements still need checking with the guest and kitchen.

walkthrough.title: 07 · Approve the brief for handoff
walkthrough.caption: Review all five details · Brief, JSON and calendar options
walkthrough.voice: With all five booking details ready, staff approves the brief. The desk offers a downloadable brief, JSON and a calendar reminder. Approval prepares the request for handoff; it does not reserve a table.

walkthrough.title: 08 · Save where your team can find it
walkthrough.caption: A clear enquiry name · This device or a private team
walkthrough.voice: Give the enquiry a useful name. Save it on this device, or choose the private Juniper House team. We save Alex's birthday dinner to the shared desk.

walkthrough.title: Pick up the same enquiry later
walkthrough.caption: Search saved enquiries · Reopen JSON · Archive when finished
walkthrough.voice: The enquiry book brings saved cases back into view. Search by a useful name, reopen the conversation, or bring back a JSON export. This device and team enquiries have separate locations.

walkthrough.title: 09 · Plan the evening
walkthrough.caption: 13 November · 8:30 pm · Six guests
walkthrough.voice: Open Service planner and choose the thirteenth of November. Alex's enquiry appears at eight-thirty with six guests, the birthday and dietary request. Staff can copy or download a handoff for the shift.

walkthrough.title: Make the next step easy to find
walkthrough.caption: Due today · Confirm the quiet table and check the allergy
walkthrough.voice: Switch to Follow-ups. The reminder is due today and says exactly what needs doing. Open the enquiry to continue, or mark the task done once the real work is complete.

walkthrough.title: 10 · Give the enquiry an owner
walkthrough.caption: Stage · Priority · Owner · Exact due time
walkthrough.voice: The team desk holds the same saved enquiry. Set Under review, a high priority and an owner. Give the next step an exact due time, with an escalation interval if it becomes overdue.

walkthrough.title: Leave the next shift a clear handoff
walkthrough.caption: Team comments stay with the enquiry
walkthrough.voice: Add a team comment so the next shift knows what to check. Staff notes and comments stay in the team workspace, separate from the guest's review page.

walkthrough.title: 11 · Let Alex check the request
walkthrough.caption: A private review page with booking details and preferences
walkthrough.voice: Create a private guest review link. Alex sees the date, time, guest count and preferences, and can send a correction or confirm the request. The page explains that a restaurant reservation still needs confirmation.

walkthrough.title: The review reaches the team
walkthrough.caption: The guest’s response comes back to the enquiry desk
walkthrough.voice: Alex submits the review and receives a receipt. The team can pick up the response in its inbox before taking the next step.

walkthrough.title: Remember a returning guest
walkthrough.caption: Reviewed guest records and previous enquiries
walkthrough.voice: The guest book keeps reviewed guest records and enquiry history together. Staff should check that a record belongs to the right person, and confirm past preferences before using them again.

walkthrough.title: 12 · Give the restaurant assistant reliable information
walkthrough.caption: Restaurant library · Reviewed and approved for guests
walkthrough.voice: In Restaurant library, the team maintains the facts guests can ask about. Here, approved dinner hours include the kitchen closing time. Publish only information your restaurant has checked.

walkthrough.title: Put the welcome on your own website
walkthrough.caption: A branded guest page and an embeddable assistant
walkthrough.voice: Open the branded guest page or copy the website widget code. Guests can ask questions and prepare an enquiry, with contact details and consent before sending it to the team.

walkthrough.title: Answers from the restaurant’s approved facts
walkthrough.caption: Dinner hours and kitchen closing time, with the source shown
walkthrough.voice: Ask when dinner is served. The guest assistant shows Juniper House's approved hours and their source. Particular requests are passed to the team for checking.

walkthrough.title: 13 · Keep channel replies reviewable
walkthrough.caption: Email and WhatsApp connectors are simulated
walkthrough.voice: The email and WhatsApp connections are simulated. Here, a follow-up email reaches Alex's existing enquiry. Staff asks for a reply draft, checks the wording and sends a simulated response. No real guest is contacted.

walkthrough.title: 14 · Explore the reservation handoff
walkthrough.caption: OpenTable, SevenRooms, Resy and TheFork simulations
walkthrough.voice: Connections also offers reservation handoff simulations. Select an approved, saved enquiry and check the simulated availability. This lets the team explore the workflow without contacting a booking platform.

walkthrough.title: A clear finish, with the status visible
walkthrough.caption: Simulated confirmation · No real table has been reserved
walkthrough.voice: The simulated handoff returns a reference and a cancellation control. Its status stays clearly labelled. In real service, the restaurant must still make and confirm the actual reservation.

walkthrough.title: Your conversations. Your restaurant desk.
walkthrough.caption: Try FormBridge · formbridge-nlp-at2.vercel.app
walkthrough.voice: From the first message to the next shift: a conversation, a reviewable brief, useful assistance and a team that knows the next step. Open FormBridge and bring your own enquiry.

quick-walkthrough.title: One birthday. One restaurant desk.
quick-walkthrough.caption: A complete example in the main FormBridge workspace
quick-walkthrough.voice: Alex is planning a birthday at Juniper House. Add the enquiry at the main desk. The conversation becomes five booking details, ready for staff to check.

quick-walkthrough.title: 01 · Plans change
quick-walkthrough.caption: Voice input · Check the transcript before adding it
quick-walkthrough.voice: Alex sends a voice message: six guests, sometime after eight. Review the transcript, then add it. The guest count changes; the exact time stays unresolved.

quick-walkthrough.title: 02 · Get help with the reply
quick-walkthrough.caption: Desk assistant · Review, use in composer, then send
quick-walkthrough.voice: Ask the desk assistant for a warm reply suggesting eight-thirty. Review the draft and place it in the staff composer. The assistant can also propose follow-ups and shift notes.

quick-walkthrough.title: 03 · Check the accepted time
quick-walkthrough.caption: 8:30 pm · The staff offer and guest acceptance stay linked
quick-walkthrough.voice: Alex accepts eight-thirty. Open Time to check the offer and acceptance. The brief keeps its supporting messages and change history.

quick-walkthrough.title: 04 · Keep the extra care
quick-walkthrough.caption: Birthday · Quiet table · Peanut allergy
quick-walkthrough.voice: Review the birthday, quiet table and peanut allergy against Alex’s words. Keep the requests, approve the brief, and save the enquiry to the team.

quick-walkthrough.title: 05 · Plan the service
quick-walkthrough.caption: Service planner · Six guests at 8:30 pm
quick-walkthrough.voice: In Service planner, the dinner appears at eight-thirty with six guests and their requests. Follow-ups give the next shift a clear task.

quick-walkthrough.title: 06 · Give the next step an owner
quick-walkthrough.caption: Team desk · Priority, owner, due time and comments
quick-walkthrough.voice: Assign an owner, priority and due time. Team comments keep the handoff together, and the enquiry book makes the saved conversation easy to reopen.

quick-walkthrough.title: 07 · Welcome guests on your website
quick-walkthrough.caption: Restaurant-approved answers · Private guest review
quick-walkthrough.voice: The website assistant answers from approved restaurant information. A private review page lets Alex check the request and return corrections to the team.

quick-walkthrough.title: From first hello to handoff
quick-walkthrough.caption: Booking and channel connections are simulated · No table is reserved
quick-walkthrough.voice: Finally, explore email, WhatsApp and reservation handoffs in simulation. No real table is reserved. Bring your own conversations to FormBridge.
